description: The 0.17.0 regression seed as an executable registry. Each class is a recurring bug type mined from the dreams journal, sprint retros, events, and CLAUDE.md/MIGRATION.md/UPDATE.md hygiene sections (ROADMAP 'Mandatory regression seed'). `detector.run` (when non-null) is a node command the test-suite runner executes; exit 0 = class currently held closed, non-zero = possible regression. status: covered (real detector) | partial (detector approximates) | gap (no detector yet — the suite's backlog).

detector.notes: Rejects: root etc.md exists (namespace violation), etc/*.md missing standard frontmatter or ## Procedure, eval-packs failing schema, decision_records failing validate-artifact.js. S0.4 (s04-etc-harness).

The sealed-capsule-contract-gate enforcer (ADR-0006 / SP-20260602-001 keystone). --self-test proves the gate logic fail-closed: seal materializes the full BOM + verifies hashes, isolate creates an out-of-tree repo and CATCHES a planted reach-back, lifecycle/matrix fail-closed per step/cell, verifyTyped requires action+well-formed-record (BC-16) against the canonical-anchored ledger. The heavy real-matrix run is the on-demand --full / release-gate path (release-gates.js gate sealed_capsule_contract).

classes.name: Silent installer no-op in /portfolio:new (created project has no engine)

detector.notes: WI-50: createProductRepo installed MC into a new product via scripts/warp-setup.js (canonical-clone-only, NEVER shipped) existsSync-guarded, so on any CONSUMER install the guard was false and the install SILENTLY no-op'd → app files but no MC engine, dead on arrival. Fixed downstream in masterconsole 9451259; reintroduced by the 0.15.0 step-driven rewrite (E-SPINUP-STEPS-001); fixed canonically + this detector added in 0.15.1. Detector asserts the loud-install contract: installs via the SHIPPED install.ps1, enforces a .claude/framework-installed.json completeness gate, and FAILS LOUDLY (never a silent skip) — static source contract + injected-spawn behavioral checks (D1 no-op rejected, D2 failed-install rejected, D3 positive control).

classes.name: Enforcer shipped without its field (fail-closed validator declares required paths the capsule neither ships nor initializes)

detector.notes: The generalization of WI-50 + the 0.15.1 tracker gap: MC shipped a fail-closed validator (scripts/trackers/validate.js §33 REQUIRED_PATHS) but the capsule delivered neither the required framework templates (trackers/templates/* shipped to nobody) NOR an initializer (/trackers:init did not exist) — 'shipped the referee, not the field.' Detector asserts every consumer-required path a fail-closed validator declares is either SHIPPED (framework content in the manifest) or INITIALIZABLE (project content via a named initializer script+command). Closed 2026-06-06: trackers/templates promoted to owner=framework + shipped (build.js framework-trackers-templates rule + ASSET_DIRS), and /trackers:init (scripts/trackers/init.js + .claude/commands/trackers/init.md) added, producing a validator-GREEN seed. Extend DECLARERS[] when a new fail-closed validator declares consumer paths.
